prompt: You want to learn a poem by heart for next month. Which approach usually works best?

options.text: Read it once, the night before
Practise a little each day, with gaps between sessions
Read it twenty times in one long sitting
Only listen to a recording of it, once

explanation: Short practice spread over several days — called spaced practice — builds far stronger memories than the same time crammed into one sitting. The gaps are not wasted time; they are when the memory sets.
